title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Process
description: A standardized way to execute and monitor business or technical processes in a telco or digital service provider environment (TM Forum TMF701 Process Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component Process; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Process:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Process'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'Process' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:Process:<tmfId>. unique identifier

processCharacteristic.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/processCharacteristic'. A list of characteristic(s) associated to this process, capturing contextual information such as parameters, conditions, or configuration values that may influence its execution, such us priority, retryLimit, or qualityRate.

processSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/processSpecification'. A reference to a process specification defined on design time. In TMF this is a ProcessSpecificationRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced ProcessSpecification entity (urn:ngsi-ld:ProcessSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

processRelationship.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/processRelationship'. A list of links connecting the current process to other process instances, with relationshipType specifying the nature of each relationship (e.g., triggers/triggeredBy, delegates/delegatedBy, dependsOn/requiredBy).

task.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/task'. A list of taskRef or task values related to this process. In TMF this is an array of TaskRefOrValue objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Task entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Task:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/name'. The name of the process

channel.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/channel'. The channel to which the resource reference to. e.g. channel for selling product offerings, channel for opening a trouble ticket etc..

relatedEntity.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/relatedEntity'. A list of related entity(ies) to this process

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/relatedParty'. A list of related party(ies) to this process

creationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/creationDate'. Is the date when the process was created (timestamp)

state.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/state'. Possible values for the state of the Flow

externalIdentifier.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/externalIdentifier'. An identification of an entity that is owned by or originates in a software system different from the current system, for example a ProductOrder handed off from a commerce platform into an order handling system. The structure identifies the system itself, the nature of the entity within the system (e.g. class name) and the unique ID of the entity within the system. It is anticipated that multiple external IDs can be held for a single entity, e.g. if the entity passed through multiple systems on the way to the current system. In this case the consumer is expected to sequence the IDs in the array in reverse order of provenance, i.e. most recent system first in the list.

requestedCompletionDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/requestedCompletionDate'. Requested completion date for this process

completionDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/completionDate'. Effective completion date for this process

requestedStartDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/requestedStartDate'. Requested start date for this process

startDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Process/properties/startDate'. Effective start date for this process

BooleanArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Boolean(s).

value.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Boolean(s).

BooleanCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Boolean.

ChannelRef.description: The channel to which the resource reference to. e.g. channel for selling product offerings, channel for opening a trouble ticket etc..

Characteristic.description: Describes a given characteristic of an object or entity through a name/value pair. This is an abstract base class, the actual value is in one of the strongly-typed subclasses : StringCharacteristic, ObjectCharacteristic, FloatCharacteristic, BooleanCharacteristic, NumberCharacteristic, IntegerCharacteristic, StringArrayCharacteristic, ObjectArrayCharacteristic, BooleanArrayCharacteristic, NumberArrayCharacteristic, IntegerArrayCharacteristic...

valueType.description: Data type of the value of the characteristic

CharacteristicRelationship.description: Another Characteristic that is related to the current Characteristic;

EntityRef.description: Entity reference schema to be use for all entityRef class.

id.description: The identifier of the referred entity.

href.description: The URI of the referred entity.

@referredType.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

Extensible.description: Base Extensible schema for use in TMForum Open-APIs - When used for in a schema it means that the Entity described by the schema MUST be extended with the @type

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

ExternalIdentifier.description: An identification of an entity that is owned by or originates in a software system different from the current system, for example a ProductOrder handed off from a commerce platform into an order handling system. The structure identifies the system itself, the nature of the entity within the system (e.g. class name) and the unique ID of the entity within the system. It is anticipated that multiple external IDs can be held for a single entity, e.g. if the entity passed through multiple systems on the way to the current system. In this case the consumer is expected to sequence the IDs in the array in reverse order of provenance, i.e. most recent system first in the list.

owner.description: Name of the external system that owns the entity.

externalIdentifierType.description: Type of the identification, typically would be the type of the entity within the external system

id.description: identification of the entity within the external system.

FloatCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Float.

FlowCharacteristic.description: Describes a given characteristic of a flow through a name/value pair. This is an abstract base class, the actual value is in one of the strongly-typed subclasses : StringCharacteristic, ObjectCharacteristic, FloatCharacteristic, BooleanCharacteristic, NumberCharacteristic, IntegerCharacteristic, StringArrayCharacteristic, ObjectArrayCharacteristic, BooleanArrayCharacteristic, NumberArrayCharacteristic, IntegerArrayCharacteristic...

modality.description: modality of use of this characteristic, it could be for example input, output, informational or contextual

isPopulated.description: a boolean to indicate if the characteristic is populated or not

IntegerArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Integer(s).

value.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Integer(s).

IntegerCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Integer.

NumberArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Number(s).

value.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Number(s).

NumberCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Number.

ObjectArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Object(s).

ObjectCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Object.

PartyRoleRef.description: Party role reference. A party role represents the part played by a party in a given context.

partyId.description: The identifier of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

partyName.description: The name of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

ProcessRelationship.description: Describes links from the current Process to other Process instances by specifying a relationship type (e.g., triggers/triggeredBy, delegates/delegatedBy, dependsOn/requiredBy).

relationshipType.description: Type of relationship between processes such as triggers/triggeredBy, delegates/delegatedBy, dependsOn/requiredBy, etc.

RelatedEntity.description: A reference to an entity, where the type of the entity is not known in advance.

RelatedPartyRefOrPartyRoleRef.description: RelatedParty reference. A related party defines party or party role or its reference, linked to a specific entity

role.description: Role played by the related party or party role in the context of the specific entity it is linked to. Such as 'initiator', 'customer', 'salesAgent', 'user'

StringArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of String(s).

StringCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a String.
